distribution: Jinghong, Damenglong, Mengla and Simao, Yunnan.
soldier: Body medium-sized. Head brownish yellow, the portion anterior to the antennae slightly darker, the labrum and postmentum brown, the mandibles dark brown, the thorax, abdomen and appendages yellow. Setae on the head sparse, almost without fine short setae; one pair of long setae on the frons, the setae behind the antennae shorter and one to two on each side. Head a broad oval, nearly elongate-rectangular, the lateral margins slightly arcuate, widest at two-fifths of the posterior part and narrowing gradually towards the front, the posterior margin arcuate. Labrum broadly lingulate, just covering the left marginal tooth, convex in the middle and flat at the sides to form a rim. Fontanelle indistinct. The two mandibles very straight, the inner and outer margins anterior to the marginal tooth almost linear, the outer margin contracting conically forwards from the level of the tooth, the apex slightly incurved, the base notched; the notch of the left mandible deep and containing a minute pointed tooth, the tooth situated slightly behind the midpoint with its apex lateral; the right mandibular tooth very small. Postmentum about twice as long as wide. Antennae with 16–17 segments; with 16 segments, segment 3 almost equal to segment 2 and one and a half times segment 4. Pronotum rhomboidal, with notches at the middle of both the anterior and the posterior margin.
